title: Bucanus: subject is the soul — mind knows/judges; will/heart embraces
source_text: XV. Bucanus vero ad quaestionem illam, Quod est subjectum fidei in nobis? Respondet sequentibus verbis: Anima hominis, & in mente quidem tum notitia seu intelligentia, tum judicium & consensus acquiescens in verbo & promissione divina; in voluntate vero & corde, apprehensio, sive complexus. Loc. 10. quaest. 18.
pass_a_gloss: But Bucanus, to the question What is the subject of faith in us?, answers in these words: The soul of man; and in the mind indeed both knowledge or understanding and judgment and consent resting in the divine word and promise; but in the will and heart, apprehension or embrace (Loc. 10 q. 18).
pass_b_english: Bucanus: faith's subject is the human soul.
Mind: knowledge, judgment, consent to Word/promise; will and heart: apprehension/embrace.
